paite: Huchiin Bildad Sua miin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

paite: Bangtan hiai thilte gen ding na hia? huan bangtan na kama thute huih hat bang ding ahi ua?
english: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

paite: Pathianin vaihawmna a hekkawi ahia? ahihkeileh Thilbang-kimhih theiin dikna a hekkawi ahia?
english: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

paite: Na tate a tunga a khelh ua, hua a tatlekna uh khuta amaute a pikhiak a leh:
english: If your children have sinned against him, He has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

paite: Pathian lam kuhkaltaka na zona, hua Thilbangkimhihthei kianga na thilnget na bawl leh;
english: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

paite: Na siangthoua na dik leh; nang jiakin tuin ka khanglou mahmah dia, huan na diktatna omna a lohching sak ding hi.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

paite: Huan na kipatna neu mahleh, ahihhangin na tawpna na nunglam nakpiin a khang ding hi.
english: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

paite: Huai jiakin ka honngen ahi, hun masa thu kan inla, a pipute un a na zonkhiak uh lamah kisuk in:
english: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

paite: (Ei lah jana lel i hi ua, bangmah i theikei uh, leitungah i nite uh lah limliap ahi a: )
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

paite: Amauten nang a honsinsak un, a honhilh un, a lungtang ua kipanin thute a gen kei ding ua hia?
english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

paite: Buannawi louin phaipek a khang khe thei ahia? tui louin loupa a khangthei ahia?
english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

paite: Hinga a oma, sat puk louh a hihlaiin, loupa dangte main a vuai nak hi.
english: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

paite: Huaibangmahin Pathian manghilhte tengteng lampi ahi; huan pathianlimsaklou mi lametna a mangthang ding:
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man shall perish,

paite: A muanna a kitam dinga, a kingakna maimomlen ahi hi.
english: Whose confidence shall break apart, Whose trust is a spider’s web.

paite: A intung a ngai dia, himahleh a ding kei ding: huaiah a lenchinten dia, himahleh a pangsawt kei ding hi.
english: He shall lean on his house, but it shall not stand. He shall cling to it, but it shall not endure.

paite: Ni suah main a hinga, huan a selte a huan tuamin a meng khia uh.
english: He is green before the sun. His shoots go forth over his garden.

paite: A zungte leivum kimah a jam ua, suangte omna mun ah a hing hi.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

paite: A mun akipan lakmang hi leh, huchiin amah a kitheihmohbawl dinga, Ka honmu ngeikei, chiin.
english: If he is destroyed from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

paite: Ngaiin, hiai a lampi kipahna ahia, huan lei akipanin adangte a hongsuak ding uh.
english: Behold, this is the joy of his way: out of the earth, others shall spring.

paite: Ngaiin, Pathianin mi hoihkim a paikhe kei ding, gilouhihmite leng a tungding sam kei ding hi.
english: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

paite: Na kam nuihin a hondimsak lai lai dia, na mukte kikounain.Nang honmudahte zumnain akhuh dinga; huan gilou puanin omta kei ding hi.
english: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

paite: Nang honmudahte zumnain akhuh dinga; huan gilou puanin omta kei ding hi.
english: Those who hate you shall be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked shall be no more.”
